PageMathMotion.seoDescription: Explore plane geometry formulas with draggable, parameter-driven animations.
PageMathMotion.title: Math Motion
PageMathMotion.description: Drag diagrams and change values to see formulas come alive.

circleFormulas.title: Circumference & area
circleFormulas.subtitle: Unroll the circle to get 2πr. Arrange equal sectors into a near-rectangle with base πr and height r.
circleFormulas.hint: Circumference: one full roll = 2πr. Area: sectors form a near-rectangle → S = πr × r = πr².
circleFormulas.dragInstruction: Drag the orange handle to change r

sectorArea.title: Sector area
sectorArea.subtitle: A sector is the same fraction of the circle as θ is of 360°.
sectorArea.hint: θ = 360° → full circle; θ = 180° → half the area.
sectorArea.dragInstruction: Drag the orange handle to change θ

arcLength.title: Arc length
arcLength.subtitle: An arc with angle θ is θ/360 of the full circumference.
arcLength.hint: Double θ or r, and the arc length doubles too.
arcLength.dragInstruction: Drag the orange handle around the circle

triangleDefinition.title: Definition & classification
triangleDefinition.subtitle: Elements, triangle inequality, and types by sides and angles.
triangleDefinition.definitionBody: Three non-collinear segments joined end to end form a triangle.
triangleDefinition.notationBody1: Sides by vertices: AB, BC, AC.
triangleDefinition.sideRelationBody: Any two sides sum to more than the third; their difference is less.
triangleDefinition.sideRelationTip: Check: sum of the two shorter sides > longest side.
triangleDefinition.elementsFooter: Three non-collinear segments, joined end to end
triangleDefinition.bySideFooter: Equilateral is a special isosceles triangle
triangleDefinition.byAngleFooter: At most one right or one obtuse angle

triangleAreaPerimeter.title: Area & perimeter
triangleAreaPerimeter.subtitle: Perimeter = a + b + c. Area = base × height ÷ 2 (two triangles → parallelogram).
triangleAreaPerimeter.heightBody: Perpendicular from a vertex to the opposite side’s line.
triangleAreaPerimeter.areaMethodBody: Same area: ½·BC·AD = ½·AC·BP — useful for lengths.
triangleAreaPerimeter.perimeterMeaningBody: Sum of the three sides — the boundary length.
triangleAreaPerimeter.noteBody: Sides must satisfy the triangle inequality.
triangleAreaPerimeter.playHint: Play: two congruent triangles form a parallelogram

triangleAngleSum.title: Angle sum (180°)
triangleAngleSum.subtitle: Conjecture, assemble the angles, then prove with parallels.
triangleAngleSum.verifyBody: Place the three interior angles together — they make a straight 180°.
triangleAngleSum.proofBody1: Draw EF ∥ BC through A. Alternate angles: ∠B = ∠1, ∠C = ∠2.
triangleAngleSum.assembledHint: Three angles form a straight line

pythagoreanTheorem.title: Pythagorean theorem
pythagoreanTheorem.subtitle: In a right triangle, a² + b² = c².
pythagoreanTheorem.hintBody1: Build squares outward on sides a, b, and c.
pythagoreanTheorem.playHint: Play: squares on three sides, compare areas

squareProperties.title: Properties of a square
squareProperties.subtitle: A square is a special parallelogram — both rectangle and rhombus.
squareProperties.definitionBody: A parallelogram with equal adjacent sides and one right angle.
squareProperties.properties1: 1. Four right angles; four equal sides.
squareProperties.properties2: 2. Diagonals equal, perpendicular, bisect opposite angles.
squareProperties.symmetryBody2: Also centrally symmetric about the diagonal intersection.
squareProperties.diagonals2: · Bisect each other and opposite angles
squareProperties.axesDesc: Through midpoints and through opposite vertices

squareFormula.title: Perimeter & area
squareFormula.subtitle: Four equal sides: P = 4a, S = a².
squareFormula.areaHint1: a unit squares per row, a rows.
squareFormula.playHint: Play: fill with a×a unit squares

parallelogramFormula.title: Perimeter & area
parallelogramFormula.subtitle: Opposite sides equal → P = 2(a + b). Cut & rearrange → S = base × height.
parallelogramFormula.perimeterHint1: Opposite sides: AB = CD = b, AD = BC = a.
parallelogramFormula.areaHint1: Drop a height; cut off the left right triangle.
parallelogramFormula.areaHint2: Slide it right to make a rectangle.

trapezoidArea.title: Trapezoid area
trapezoidArea.subtitle: Two congruent trapezoids → parallelogram → half: S = (a + b) × h ÷ 2.

polygonAngleSums.title: Interior & exterior angle sums
polygonAngleSums.subtitle: Split into triangles for interior sum; one full turn → exterior 360°.
polygonAngleSums.hintExterior: Exterior: one full turn is always 360°.
polygonAngleSums.exteriorGuide: Extend a side at each vertex → exterior β
polygonAngleSums.playHint: Play: triangle split and exterior sum

rectangleProperties.title: Properties of a rectangle
rectangleProperties.intro: A quadrilateral with four right angles.
points: Diagonals equal and bisect each other.

rectangleFormula.title: Perimeter & area
rectangleFormula.intro: Described by length l and width w.
points: Two lengths l, two widths w.

parallelogramProperties.title: Properties of a parallelogram
points: Opposite angles equal; consecutive angles supplementary.

trapezoidDefinition.title: Definition of a trapezoid
trapezoidDefinition.intro: Exactly one pair of parallel sides.
points: Distance between bases is height h.
Isosceles trapezoid is a common special case.

trapezoidProperties.title: Properties of a trapezoid
trapezoidProperties.intro: Properties from one pair of parallel sides.
points: Angles on the same leg are supplementary.
Isosceles: equal legs and equal base angles.

rhombusDefinition.title: Definition of a rhombus
rhombusDefinition.intro: A parallelogram with four equal sides.

regularPolygonDefinition.title: Regular polygon
regularPolygonDefinition.intro: Equal sides and equal interior angles.
points: Examples: equilateral triangle, square, regular pentagon.
Inscribed in a circle; equal center-to-vertex distances.
More sides → closer to a circle.

regularPolygonAngleSum.title: Interior angle sum
regularPolygonAngleSum.intro: From one vertex, split into (n−2) triangles.
